arabic text: KAISI YEH SHAAM AYEE AULAADE SAYYADA PAR
english translation text: WHAT KIND OF NIGHT HAS COME UPON THE CHILDREN OF LADY ZAHRA?

arabic text: SAJJAD RO RAHE HAIN, ZAINAB SE MOON CHUPA KAR
english translation text: SAJJAD WEEPS, HIDING HIS FACE FROM ZAINAB.

arabic text: EK SAMT BE KAFAN HAI BHAI KA USKE LAASHA
english translation text: ON ONE SIDE LIES HER BROTHER’S SHROUDED-LESS BODY,

arabic text: ABBAS KI BEHEN KA BAAQI RAHA NA PARDA
english translation text: THE SISTER OF ABBAS HAS NO VEIL LEFT.

arabic text: AB SOCHTI HAI ZAINAB MANGE KAFAN YA CHADAR
english translation text: NOW ZAINAB WONDERS — SHOULD SHE ASK FOR A SHROUD OR A VEIL?

arabic text: BAAZU KAHAN PAREY HAIN LAASHA KAHAN PARA HAI
english translation text: WHERE ARE THE ARMS LYING, WHERE DOES THE BODY LIE?

arabic text: ZAINAB KI BEBASI PAR GHAZI TARAP RAHA HAI
english translation text: AT ZAINAB’S HELPLESSNESS, GHAZI IS RESTLESS.

arabic text: ROTI HAI BEKASI BHI FARSH-E-AZA BICHA KAR
english translation text: EVEN HELPLESSNESS ITSELF WEEPS, SPREADING A MAT OF MOURNING.

arabic text: JO GHAR MEIN DO QADAM BHI PAIDAL NAHI CHALI HAI
english translation text: SHE, WHO HAD NEVER TAKEN TWO STEPS OUTSIDE HER HOME,

arabic text: EK DIN MEIN WO HI ZAINAB ABBAS BAN GAYI HAI
english translation text: IN ONE DAY, THAT VERY ZAINAB HAS BECOME ABBAS.

arabic text: PEHRE PE AAGAYI HAI TANHA ALAM UTHA KAR
english translation text: SHE HAS COME TO STAND GUARD, RAISING THE STANDARD ALONE.

arabic text: SAJJAD SE LIPAT KAR KEHTI RAHI SAKINA
english translation text: SAKINA CLUNG TO SAJJAD, SAYING AGAIN AND AGAIN,

arabic text: EHSAAS HO RAHA HAI ME HOGAI YATEEMA
english translation text: 'I FEEL AS THOUGH I HAVE BECOME AN ORPHAN.'

arabic text: ZALIM DARA RAHA HAI NAIZA DIKHA DIKHA KAR
english translation text: THE TYRANT FRIGHTENS ME, WAVING HIS SPEAR.

arabic text: LAASHON KE DARMIYAN WO BABA KO DHONDHTI HAI
english translation text: AMONG THE CORPSES, SHE SEARCHES FOR HER FATHER,

arabic text: MOON APNA PEET KAR YE FARYAD KAR RAHI HAI
english translation text: BEATING HER FACE, SHE CRIES OUT:

arabic text: QADMON MEIN HI SULA DO BABA MUJHE BULAKAR
english translation text: 'LAY ME TO SLEEP AT YOUR FEET, O BABA, CALL ME TO YOU.'

arabic text: JAB AGAYE NAJAF SE BATI KO MILNE BABA
english translation text: WHEN BABA CAME FROM NAJAF TO MEET HIS DAUGHTER,

arabic text: ZAANO PAY RAKH KAY SAR YE KEHNE LAGI WO DUKHIYA
english translation text: SHE PLACED HER HEAD ON HIS LAP AND SAID, SORROWFULLY:

arabic text: ZAINAB UJAR GAI HAI KARBOBALA BASA KAR
english translation text: 'ZAINAB HAS BEEN RUINED WHILE KARBALA WAS DEVASTATED.'

arabic text: KHAIMON KE SAATH JHULA BISTAR BHI JAL GAYA HAI
english translation text: ALONG WITH THE TENTS, THE CRADLES AND BEDDING TOO WERE BURNT,

arabic text: NAMOOS-E-MUSTAFA KO BAGHI KAHA GAYA HAI
english translation text: THE CHILDREN OF MUSTAFA HAVE BEEN CALLED REBELS.

arabic text: LE JAYENGE SUBHA KO QAIDI HUME BANA KAR
english translation text: BY MORNING, THEY WILL TAKE US AWAY AS PRISONERS.

arabic text: GUZREGI KAISI YAWAR MAQTAL SE SHAHZAADI
english translation text: HOW WILL THE PRINCESS PASS THROUGH THE BATTLEFIELD, O YAWAR?

arabic text: ABID NE RAAT MOMIN YE SOCH KAR GUZARI
english translation text: ABID SPENT THE WHOLE NIGHT THINKING THIS.

arabic text: ZAINAB KA NAAM LEGA ZALIM TO MUSKURAKAR
english translation text: WHEN THE TYRANT WILL CALL ZAINAB’S NAME, HE WILL DO SO WITH A SMILE.
